# Origin

This directory is the browser `libghostty-vt` adapter used by the desktop
terminal, copied from an external desktop tree at Ghostty revision
`native/libghostty-vt/VERSION`.

Do not rewrite `core.ts`, `runtime.ts`, `renderer.ts`, `surface.ts`, or
`keyCodes.ts`. Wiring-only files: `assets.ts`, `platform.ts`, `appearanceFonts.ts`.
WASM artifacts are generated by the upstream `apps/web/scripts/build-libghostty-wasm.sh`.
